meta.parties: Palaniappa Chetty v. Mercantile Bank of India Et Al

rules.statement: In computing the period of thirty days within which an application for leave to appeal should be made under Rule 2 of Schedule 1 of the Appeals (Privy Council) Ordinance, the days included in a vacation of the Supreme Court should not be reckoned.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the same reasons that are given in the judgment of Poyser J., in Pathmanathan v. The 'Imperial Bank of India, I am of opinion that section 8 of the Supreme Court (Vacation) Ordinance can be invoked in this case"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 8 of the Supreme Court (Vacation) Ordinance (Cap. 1O)
